headline: State Street Investment Management President and CEO Yie-Hsin Hung on State Street’s 230-year journey growing alongside America
summary: State Street Investment Management President and CEO Yie-Hsin Hung reflects on the company’s 230 year lineage, from its origins financing commerce and trade in the early U.S. economy to its evolution into a global asset manager.
